summary: Curate native Web Search citations into a concise, relevant, primary-source-focused list.
features: Prefer URLs cited by the final response instead of displaying every raw search candidate.
Canonicalize source URLs, remove common tracking parameters, and deduplicate equivalent pages.
Prioritize current primary or official sources, direct pages, and accurate publication and event dates.
Keep community evidence available when useful while requiring it to be clearly described as anecdotal.
Keep automatic Workshop Memory release synchronization enabled.
fixes: Cap visible sources at eight in both backend and frontend rendering.
Prevent unrelated search candidates, archive pages, pagination, and stale results from overwhelming cited sources.
Strip UTM and common advertising or social tracking parameters before source comparison and display.
Preserve Web Auto, On, and Off behavior, Developer Mode isolation, tool activity, and approval boundaries.
validation: Citation-first selection, URL canonicalization, deduplication, and bounded-fallback regression coverage
Primary-source search guidance and eight-source frontend cap coverage
Release and Workshop Memory synchronization metadata validation
